name: Ember Legion
description:
About This Game

After rifts from another realm tore the world asunder, hope flickers like a candle in the wind—its last embers scattered and faint.

You are the final hero, tasked with reclaiming your lost homeland. Kindle beacons of hope, recruit loyal soldiers, and forge your legion. By day, you are a wise commander: gather scarce resources, build barracks, research powerful gear, and launch swift assaults on enemy strongholds. By night, you become an unbreakable bulwark—orchestrating diverse troops to repel waves of light-fearing horrors surging from the darkness.

Key Features

• Lightweight RTS Experience
No tedious micromanagement or complex economy. We focus on the core joy of strategy: making smart, impactful decisions with limited resources. Build your army fast and dive straight into intense, pure RTS combat.

• Unique Day-Night Attack-Defense Cycle
The game world pulses with a dynamic day-night rhythm. Daylight is your golden hour—explore, expand, and prepare for the coming onslaught. When night falls, hordes of otherworldly creatures swarm your camp, launching relentless waves of attacks. Mastering this cycle is the key to victory.

• Deep Troop & Gear Synergies
Recruit unique units: heavily armored "Shieldbearers," swift and deadly "Horse Archers," and long-range "Ballista Crews." Each has distinct strengths and roles. Customize them with a rich arsenal of weapons and armor to craft countless powerful combinations tailored to any battlefield challenge.

• Rekindle Hope, Reclaim the Land
Your goal isn’t just survival—it’s reconquest. Lead your legion to liberate corrupted outposts one by one, rekindling the beacons of hope across the shattered continent. Every victory brings light, life, and renewal back to this broken world.
short_desc: 《Ember Legion》 is a lightweight RTS. Rifts shattered the world—hope lingers in embers. Choose a hero, build a legion, attack by day, defend by night. Master day-night cycles and troop combos to reclaim your homeland.
